summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET web page for staff administrators, implemented as a partial class inheriting HSPnet.Framework.HSPnetPage, with a web form view managed via LeftNav.Master. It includes controls for filtering and viewing student employment applications, error and warning panels, and a grid to display application data.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to filter, view, and manage student employment applications, including the ability to search by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.

workflows.name: Page Load and Initialization
steps: SetupHSPnetPage with master and user session.
Set page title and last login information.
Fill dropdown controls for Site and Discipline.
Set default date range (last 3 months to today).
Call RefreshData to bind initial grid content.

workflows.name: Filtering Applications
steps: Staff admin selects Site, Discipline, Start Date, End Date, or Withdrawn status.

workflows.name: Validation and Error Handling
steps: Required field validators and regular expression validators validate input dates.
Custom validator (checkStartEnd) ensures Start Date <= End Date.
Error and warning panels display validation messages.

workflows.name: Grid Rendering and Row Binding
steps: RowDataBound event formats and displays application details.

business_rules: Start Date and End Date must be valid and required.
Withdrawn applications can be optionally shown.
If Start Date is after End Date, validation fails.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for Start Date and End Date.
CustomValidator ensures Start Date not after End Date.
calculations: Date range defaults to last 3 months to today.
conditions: Show withdrawn filter determines whether withdrawn applications are included.
Panel visibility depends on error or warning presence.
Last login only shown if available.
system_behavior: AutoPostBack on dropdowns for real-time filtering.
Error and warning panels float for visibility.
Default button set for form submission.
Scripts registered for calendar and date functionality.
exceptions: Missing required fields trigger validation errors.
No data shown if filters yield empty result.
content_gaps: Business logic for SearchSubmitted and actual EmploymentApplication data not included.
No explicit description of security/authorization mechanisms.
Some fields and controls referenced in summaries, but actual UI/UX details may be incomplete.
